entries.not_relevant_because: The family proves Uchida's conjecture: a continuous open homomorphism between absolute Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields is induced by a unique equivariant field embedding. That concerns Galois groups of number fields, not the fundamental groups of complete smooth curves over finitely generated fields, not splittings of the map from such a fundamental group to G_k, and not k-rational points on curves. A search of the remaining sections and the references finds no mention of curves, sections, splittings, Grothendieck, or fundamental groups of curves; the word 'splitting' occurs only in Kummer and exact-sequence contexts. The shared anabelian background is thematic and does not make the family bear on the section conjecture.
